title: P2-S5 — O1 gatebraid-ready: the fourth attempt on the frozen scope
body:
# P2-S5 — O1 gatebraid-ready: the fourth attempt on the frozen scope

## Goal

Deliver M3-PLAN §2 node **O1**: the fourth `gatebraid-ready` attempt —
repaying the ready-scope debt on the **same frozen scope** as the three
M2 slice-C attempts, with **evidence generated by N2, validated by N3,
and state read through O0 outputs**. The scope is frozen: it is read at
Gate 1 from the M2 slice-C historical record in
`MianliWang/gatebraid-scratch`, never re-derived from memory, and the
Gate 1 plan pins it by hash. Implementation greenness alone is
explicitly **not** the success criterion (M3-PLAN §2 O1).

## Context

- Why now: the DAG runs `N0 → N1 → {N2, N3} → O0 → O1 → …`, and **O1
  requires N2 + N3 + O0 accepted** — all closed: N2 = P2-S1 `#8`;
  N3 = P2-S2 `#10`, its arc completed by the P2-S3 repair Slice `#12`
  (validator repair plus the owed N2 re-validation run to completion);
  O0 = P2-S4 `#14`, PR `#16` merged at commit
  `7ff1f848661aac20b3921ae47fe140394a5d2587`.
- Startability: this Slice's Gate 0 is the **first exercise of the
  hardened `gatebraid-snapshot` / `gatebraid-frontier` pair as sole
  startability authority** (gate-0-contract Entry, the After-O0 clause).
  The state-packet mechanism is spent — its final enumerated use was
  P2-S4's own Gate 0.
- Lane structure per ADR-0032 decision 2: a control-repository Slice's
  allowlist keeps the ADR-0014/0016 shape — `bin/` plus its evidence
  directory, and nothing else. Schemas and fixtures are batch-lane
  territory; this Slice consumes the batch-frozen corpus (its historical
  ready-failure mutations included) and authors none of it.
- The M2-era ready attempts in `MianliWang/gatebraid-scratch` are
  readable historical record — superseded where re-built, not moved
  (ADR-0032 decision 1's pattern).
- Related: Phase P2 `#7` · P2-S1 `#8` · P2-S2 `#10` · P2-S3 `#12` ·
  P2-S4 `#14` · PR `#16` · M3-PLAN §2 O1 · ADR-0025 §8 · ADR-0030 ·
  ADR-0032.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Gate 3 exit with `R3 first-pass = pass` (M3-PLAN §2 O1
      Accept-when).
- [ ] `evidence-only repairs = 0` and `evidence-only aborts = 0` across
      the Slice.
- [ ] All historical mutations killed: every historical ready-failure
      class in the frozen corpus is demonstrably killed, shown by seeded
      runs with summaries emitted by the instruments themselves — never
      by narration.
- [ ] Evidence generated by N2's `bin/gatebraid-capture.py` and
      validated by N3's `bin/gatebraid-validate.py` on the declared
      platforms; control-plane state read exclusively through O0 outputs
      (`bin/gatebraid-snapshot.py` / `bin/gatebraid-frontier.py`), never
      through ad-hoc queries.

## Non-goals

No `schema/` or `fixtures/` write in this Slice — both are batch-lane
territory. No edit to the five landed tool pairs
(`bin/gatebraid-capture*.py`, `bin/gatebraid-validate*.py`,
`bin/gatebraid-snapshot*.py`, `bin/gatebraid-frontier*.py`,
`bin/gatebraid-o0-acceptance*.py`). No guard or doctor work (P's). No
`gate-run@2` schema revision (its own batch lane, by ADR). No edit to
any merged historical record. No O0 re-work.

title: Stage S2 — M3: the committed evidence toolchain
body:
# Stage S2 — M3: the committed evidence toolchain

M3 converts M2's measured findings into a reviewable, refusable,
non-expanding toolchain: the hardened state pipeline, the committed
evidence generator and its independent validator, guard and doctor,
minimum enforcement and skills — closing at objective admission criteria
(M3-PLAN.md §1, ratified by ADR-0029).

## Scope

- The frozen corpus (v1.1) and the instruments measured against it
- N2's evidence generator and N3's independent validator, each landed
  once through its own gate (ADR-0028 decision 4; ADR-0032 decision 1)
- The later M3 phases per M3-PLAN.md §2's DAG

## Phases

title: Phase P1 — Sample hierarchy and dependency encoding
body:
# Phase P1 — Sample hierarchy and dependency encoding

Builds the four-Slice sample hierarchy in the scratch repository and encodes
the two ADR-0007 dependency forms across it: metadata-only edges for Gate 1
and Gate 2 predecessors, and metadata plus a native blocked-by edge for the
single Gate 3 predecessor. The Phase exists so the soft and hard encodings can
be observed diverging on the same graph.

## Slices

<!-- Maintained as sub-issues; list here is informational and may lag. -->

- P1-S2 — Build on the interface A fixes at Gate 1 (sub-issue, in MianliWang/gatebraid-scratch)
- P1-S3 — Consume A's released output (sub-issue, in MianliWang/gatebraid-scratch)
- P1-S4 — Integrate B and C (sub-issue, in MianliWang/gatebraid-scratch)
- P1-S5 — Consume A's released output (sub-issue, in MianliWang/gatebraid-scratch) — successor to the aborted P1-S3

title: Stage S1 — Control-plane validation

# Stage S1 — Control-plane validation

Validates the Gatebraid Classic control plane end to end on the scratch
repository: the Stage/Phase/Slice hierarchy, the two dependency encodings of
ADR-0007, and the Project field contract of spec §1–§3. This Stage delivers
evidence that the control plane behaves as specified before any business work
is admitted to it.

## Scope

- A four-Slice sample hierarchy carrying both dependency encodings.
- A read-only verification pass proving metadata and native edges agree with
  ADR-0007.
